about: Authored schema for this lane only. Maps a source rig's bone names to a target rig's bone names so one attack clip can be reused across body plans. Based on the three.js SkeletonUtils.retargetClip technique (three.js is MIT licensed; no three.js code is staged here, only this mapping shape).
rules: Every target bone in the map must exist in the target rig; unmapped bones keep their rest pose — never silently drop a mapped bone.
Non-humanoid body plans (quadruped, serpentine, floating, seated) get their own map file; do not force them through the biped map.
A retargeted clip must pass the same gates as a hand-made clip: rest-pose return error near zero, no ground penetration, no joint inversion.
Record source clip id, target rig id, and map file id together; a clip without its map is not shippable.
source: three.js SkeletonUtils.retargetClip, documented pattern: hip bone name + names map of target bone -> source bone. three.js licence: MIT.

wiring_target.owning_step_agent: Step 1 (attack + hurt) for clip reuse; Step 2 (battle integration) for runtime playback
wiring_target.target_module: 3D / rig playback path that consumes the lane's rigged models; 2D fallback is the existing atlas + treatments module, not this schema
